reason: COMPLEX. The first thing I noticed was 30 little foil sachets, which feels like trash to me, but I already take a multi-form complex and the one-hand tear packets would be easy in my travel bag twice a month. I would try one box of the 3-form one, not the single bisglycinate.
objection: $29.99 is double what I pay for my usual flash-sale bottle, and 30 foil packets is a lot of waste for something I could just put in a pill case.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $20 to $22 for the box, or a smaller travel pack so I can try it without 30 sachets of foil.
